issues.on_page: General Fund combining schedules: Parks & Recreation Fund (disbursements 20,117.94), Bradshaw Days Fund (receipts 7,567.00 / disbursements 10,039.70), TIF Fund (receipts 149,717.90 / disbursements 81,642.43) columns
issues.issue: The combining receipts/disbursements schedules continue on printed pages 28 and 30, which are not in the trimmed PDF, so detail[] only covers the General, Community Center and RV Park columns. The extractor notes this. Detail for these sub-funds is incomplete through no fault of the extraction; the trimming may need to include those pages.

issues.on_page: Transfers to Other Funds 6,000.00 printed below Total Disbursements 95,750.85
issues.issue: This other financing line is printed below the schedule's Total Disbursements line, so under the rules it should have outside_printed_total: true. The detail_totals amount is correct (95,750.85 excludes it).

issues.on_page: State Revolving Fund And Bond Proceeds 287,315.00 (Exh IV); Statement of Activities (p2) shows the same 260,000 / 27,315 under Operating Grants and Contributions
issues.issue: Treating this as debt proceeds follows the Exh IV label, but the Statement of Activities presents it as grants/contributions (SRF loan forgiveness is possible). It is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Water Fund Property Taxes 22,931.31; Carline 83.64; Prorate 52.00; Homestead 1,161.12; Property Tax Credit 2,019.26
issues.issue: The Water Fund tax receipts match the Street Fund tax receipts on p6/p13 almost exactly (Street Pro-rate 52.01). They are recorded as printed, but the report may have duplicated Street Fund taxes into the Water Fund. Worth a human look.
'Vehicle Expenses' (also detail[39] and detail[55]) could be fuel instead of repairs and maintenance; the object is not stated.
